display.title: Sponsor Message: Lagavina Kosher Cheese (Playing House)
display.summary_short: The radio show's sponsor jingle: two children play mommy and daddy, and lunch is Lagavina mozzarella on a toasted bagel, 'the terrificest cheese in the whole wide world'.
display.summary_long: A one-minute commercial from the sponsor of Uncle Yossi's Tzivos Hashem on the Air in the mid-1980s. Two children play house: 'You be the mommy and I'll be the daddy.' For lunch the 'mommy' serves Lagavina mozzarella cheese on a toasted bagel with grilled tomato, and the 'daddy' declares Lagavina the terrificest cheese in the whole wide world, strictly kosher and supervised from the time the cows are milked. When he worries that it must be expensive, she explains that its prices compare with any other kosher cheese, so he says they should buy more, but he will have to ask mommy. 'But you are the mommy!' The spot ends with the slogan 'Don't say cheese, say Lagavina.' The same commercial ran in many episodes of the program during 1984-1985.

date.note: Inherits the air date of episode 162 (f826c5f743). Episode: 'Tonight is Tu B'Shvat, the fifteenth day of Shevat': evening of Tue 1985-02-05.
